name: Mondaire Jones
summary:
Mondaire Lamar Jones (born May 18, 1987) is an American lawyer and politician serving as a member of the United States Commission on Civil Rights since 2023. A member of the Democratic Party, Jones was the U.S. representative for New York's 17th congressional district from 2021 to 2023.
In Congress, his political ideology aligned with the progressive wing of the Democratic Party.
